description: This file defines a custom validation annotation @FieldMatch used to ensure two fields in a Java class have the same value, typically for confirming password or email fields during validation. It includes documentation, target annotations, and an inner @interface List for multiple field comparisons, along with references to the validator class.

classes.name: FieldMatch
classes.description: A custom annotation for validating that two specified fields in a Java class have matching values, used for form validation such as password confirmation.

classes.name: FieldMatch.List
classes.description: An inner annotation allowing multiple @FieldMatch annotations to be applied to the same class to compare multiple pairs of fields.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Returns the default validation error message if fields do not match.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Provides metadata information for clients of the Bean Validation API.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Specifies the name of the first field to compare.

methods.name: second
methods.description: Specifies the name of the second field to compare.
